notes.title: 1.2 TIDE Update
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Scaper![/h3]

We're thrilled to present you the new [b]TIDE[/b] update - all about trade and the vast seas! Packed with exciting new features, mechanics, and rebalanced gameplay. Plus, there are new scenarios to master. We've also made numerous improvements to graphics and performance.

We haven't just enhanced the visuals of Terras' waters - we've made them more engaging too: With new buildings and complexes, we're adding more possibilities to the game, and the <<Merchant>> makes his debut. Now you'll have another way to obtain buildings and extras, and - when things get tight or you simply have too much on hand - to trade and barter.

[h3]Check out our 'highly informative' TIDE trailer...[/h3]
[previewyoutube=FBMlC3uYKP8;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Card Trading[/h3]
The merchant has landed on your island with his boat and now offers his services. In addition to the regular deck draw (which you can now reroll for diamonds), you'll have access to a new trade and exchange menu. This merchant lets you trade unwanted or excess cards for buildings you currently need or simply want to construct. But his services don't come entirely free.

[h3]Fresh Waters[/h3]
The seas and lakes of Terras now have much more depth! :) We've completely reworked the water visuals from the seabed up. There's now much more to discover - or you can just watch the lively activity. Ocean resources are also easier to spot now. But beware: With new opportunities come greater challenges in strategically planning your fishing fleet!

[h3]Scenarios, Puzzles & Quests[/h3]
The update brings three new scenarios, five new puzzle-terras, and revisions to existing scenarios and puzzles. Some quests in scenarios now count retroactively, and the Marshland Deck gets its own puzzles. We've also overhauled the quest user interface for better clarity and readability.

[h3]New Buildings[/h3]
Some buildings have been replaced to better fit with decks. The old versions aren't gone though - they'll remain available as deckless buildings. Plenty of new building complexes with unique effects and awesome graphics are joining the game, including the first river-utilizing complex - happy exploring!

[h3]New Resources[/h3]
New, more-or-less unique resources will enrich the game world with their own special atmosphere. While many will benefit from them, some might occasionally get in the way.

[h3]Technology[/h3]
With update 1.2 TIDE, we've not only expanded our development environment but also upgraded our processes and software to the latest standards. By updating to Unity 6 and its new capabilities (which we haven't even fully explored yet), we're delivering numerous performance improvements and optimizations.

- Unity Engine Upgrade
- Improved performance handling
- Faster intro and game start

[b]The release was a great success for us, we hoped that many of you would come back to celebrate the new features and 1.0 with us, but what happened with the full release of TerraScape exceeded all our expectations and we are mega happy that so many players are happy with 1.0. [quote][i]INSTINCT3 (HandOfBlood, Cofounder, image above) is originally an influencer marketing agency focused on creative campaigns and influencer management, representing some of the biggest content creators in gaming from Germany like HandOfBlood. In 2024, they started their own indie publishing venture and became the official Co-Publisher of TerraScape, supporting us especially in (Influencer-) Marketing, PR and whatever else helps us and the game grow in the GSA Region.[/i][/quote]

To give you all a little more time to take on HandOfBlood and everyone else on the leaderboard, we've decided to extend this special challenge as a Special Event for another week! 
Of course, you won't have to miss out on a new weekly challenge: For a short time, two parallel challenges will be available to you.
And who knows? Maybe there will be one or two additional challenges as special events in the future...

notes.title: TerraScape Release 1.0
notes.content:
[h1]Reached a Milestone[/h1]

[previewyoutube=DGVdDWpMYUE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Dear Scapers,[/b]

It has been a long journey through Early Access with you. We had a lot of fun, were thrilled by your reviews and feedback, faced some issues that we were able to solve thanks to your help, found new friends and hyper-motivated challengers. TerraScape started as an idea in 2019 as a student project with the thought of incorporating some cool mechanics from big 4X games as well as small, quick casual games, and creating something ‘in between’. We love strategy games and wanted to create something that both strategy game players and casual gamers would enjoy. Thus, the foundation for TerraScape was laid. Today, we are super proud of what has become of the small spark of an idea, and it has grown larger than we ever believed possible. We would like to thank everyone who accompanied us on this journey, were there in difficult situations, and stood by us as good teachers when we didn't know how to proceed.

[b]The fact that this project is enjoyed by thousands of players and brings them fun is the highest praise.[/b]

But the journey is far from over; we have reached a major milestone. Our very first own game at Bitfall Studios. We have a lot more planned, not only for future projects but also for TerraScape. We will let you know soon what exactly is coming - but one thing is promised: alongside small QOL (quality of life) improvements and fixes, many new scenarios and puzzles, as well as completely new mechanics and accessibility features, as well as improved Steam Deck compatibility, are on the way. We hope you enjoy version 1.0 and that we can continue to rely on your feedback in the future. Enough of the sentimentalities, we hope you have a ton of fun scaping!

[b]Once again, thank you all very much for your support![/b] [url=https://discord.gg/6FZcuP3WtM]We would love to see you on our Discord to keep in touch.[/url]


[h2]What's new in 1.0?[/h2]
[list]
[*] Legendary Building Cards
[*] 5 unique new biomes (Arid, Swamp, Thicket, Rural, Urban, ...)
[*] Improved procedural map generation with varying map shapes
[*] Complete rework and improvement of the ingame UI and UX
[*] “Deck Tree” - A tech-tree like progress menu, which shows the current status and the current deck development tree
[*] New resources on Terra
[*] 3+ new Merged Buildings
[*] 13+ new Buildings
[*] Reworked current decks and 3+ whole new decks
[*] Complete overhaul of the balancing
[*] Full rework of the Scenario Objective System
[*] New scenarios with new objectives
[/list]

[h2]Full Changelog[/h2]
[h3]3D[/h3]

notes.title: Voyage Update
notes.content:
[b]Dear Scaper,[/b]

The time has come! It's been quiet for a long time, we've fixed a lot of bugs and ironed out a lot of annoying little things. But now it's time to announce the long-awaited Voyage update and make it available to you. 
This update brings many changes, including many that you won't see directly and will only notice because the game simply runs a lot smoother and faster. But in the meantime, we have also prepared TerraScape for some major new features that require many adjustments. 
But first to the really cool new stuff!


[h1]The Voyage Update[/h1]

[previewyoutube=-dfiFjb9NTA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]TL;DR[/h2]
[list]
[*] Main menu rework
[*] Completely new representation of building placement, range, influence points and  highlighting of building complexes
[*] New animation for obtaining points for buildings on place
[*] Blueprints/Ping and map overlays (controller) are now quickly selectable via right-click and ring menu
[*] controller support (full Steam deck support is coming in the future)
[*] A new but important building complex
[*] Anti-Cheat mechanisms
[*] Performance improvements when placing buildings, merging and loading terrain
[*] Unique rewards for the weekly challenges when you reach bronze, silver and gold
[*] Animals now walk freely on their little hexagons and are no longer rooted to the ground
[*] New map overlay for displaying buildings (type)
[*] Reworked the puzzle map menu
[/list]


[h2]Explanation of individual features[/h2]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/fccb47bc47127857da0dad952c209a1ed7bd7048.png[/img]
[h3]New Main menu UI[/h3]
We thought about whether we should continue to use and refresh the old TerraScape main menu a lot. But with the recent update of the logo and the great artwork, we decided: 'Everything’s gonna be new!’ And we are happy with the result and we hope you are too. The new menu is clearer and easier to use, many elements have been combined and a familiar view, like for example a vertical list of Terras, has been used to guarantee easy navigation for controllers too.

Overall, we hope that it is now easier to read and more intuitive to use, even on particularly small and large screens.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/f0c00ea30f1121585ec66ad2250e6e9584116ff0.png[/img]
[h3]Reworked building preview[/h3]
One of the highlights is the complete overhaul of the building preview. Previously, individual hexagons were highlighted to show the range and influences of a building. Now we have improved this: if you want to build a building, you will now have a much clearer and more concise view of the range and the influences it contains. The preview of the influence points has also been improved and simplified.  
When having at least one hexagon of a Merged Building within range, the entire Merged Building will be highlighted now. This makes it much easier to see and understand which Merged Building actually influences the total score of a building.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/594efe658c13b0c83daf445037c819c6ad4fb8ad.gif[/img]
[h3]New points collection animation[/h3]
Many players have given us feedback, one of the repeatedly feedbacked issues was the view and effect of the 'wave' which were not sufficiently understandable or even unintentionally caused problems. So we wrapped our heads around it and built a completely new effect, which should now be much easier to understand but also more attractive. Depending on how many points (or even minus points) you get, a small or large shooting star is generated, which then makes its way to the building’s points badge. See for yourself.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/3a74f109fb04182a9257f20c2e9ae8b8e1e0b437.gif[/img]
[h3]Blueprints and Overlay - Quick access (Radial menu)[/h3]
Many of you are enthusiastic users of the recently added QoL features Blueprint and Ping, many found this addition more than helpful and we have already seen really complicated and impressive plans from you on how to plan your settlement construction. That's why we want to accommodate you and no longer hide this menu in the bottom corner, but make it available right where you need it. With a simple right-click on a hexagon, you can now open this menu to quickly place Blueprints and Pings. This should speed things up considerably.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/09d7ff5a54919b496de72f0d81f2f4aec4447b91.png[/img]
[h3]Controller Support[/h3]
The fact that you can now play TerraScape from the comfort of your couch or lean back and relax with a controller is one of the biggest improvements. All known controllers (as long as they have buttons and are not designed for flight or driving simulators) are now supported, both in the main menu and in the game. This gives you completely new possibilities for relaxing with a round of TerraScape. Controller functionality is also an essential basis for playing with the Steam Deck, for which we definitely want to make TerraScape suitable.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/91bc79659e2b9554b0c158d40c39d6a48c0dbd78.gif[/img]
[h3]New Merged Building[/h3]
Some of you will certainly not be satisfied over the fact that there is only one new building combination, but we promise you that this will not be the last. The new Merged Building has a smaller formation and is the first to consist of only 3 hexagons. We are very much looking forward to your feedback about this Merged Building and would like to know whether such small combinations are also fun, so that we can provide you with more of them.

[h3]Anti-Cheat Engine[/h3]
Unfortunately, some of you and also us have had a few annoyances with one or two not quite fair players. That's why we've come up with a mechanism to combat illegal entries in the leaderboards and cheaters in multiplayer. Of course, anyone can cheat in a solo game as they wish, but they will have to live with the fact that they will not be able to collect any experience points or progress in quests in that round. However, we must remain fair and the global leaderboards should remain 100% honest. As soon as a cheat is recognised, this is indicated by a small symbol - even in the multiplayer game.

[h3]Performance Improvements[/h3]
It almost goes without saying that we are always working to make the gaming experience as smooth and pleasant as possible. That's why for most of you, performance improvements are probably part of everyday life. We've slimmed down some heavyweights and added new mechanics to improve the feel, loading and overall gameplay.

[h2]At the end[/h2]
As you will have noticed, we have reached the end of our Early Access roadmap. We weren't quite able to meet one or two deadlines, and we released a few unplanned updates in between because we didn't want to keep some things to ourselves any longer. All in all, this means that version 1.0 is just around the corner.There is still a lot to do until then. TerraScape has grown up together with you and you have influenced it much more than we thought at the beginning. The community has had a huge influence on the game’s journey still has! We still hope that you will give us lots of feedback on what can be improved and what needs to be added to the game to make it a great experience.




[h2]Changes & new Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Unique rewards for Weekly Challenges (bronze/silver/gold)
[*] Main Menu rework
[*] New Merged Building: Fishing Outpost
[*] Anti-Cheat mechanism; when cheating…
[list]
[*] you see an icon that indicates cheat detection (in single player and multiplayer sessions)
[*] your highscores will not be saved (neither locally nor in Steam/GOG Leaderboards)
[*] you do not get any Steam/GOG Achievements within this session
[*] your Terra Goals in Scenarios won’t progress within this session
[*] your Ventures will not progress within this session
[*] you will not get any XP after ending this game
[/list] [*] Full Controller Support
[list]
[*] Main menu
[*] Ingame
[/list] [*] Better building preview
[list]
[*] Denoised outline for the preview
[*] Added outline for Merged Buildings
[*] Simplified influence icons
[*] New points/score animation
[/list] [*] Radial Menu
[list]
[*] Added radial menu on right click for Blueprints and ping
[*] Added radial menu (controller only) for map overlays
[/list] [*] Map overlay for built buildings
[*] Walking Animals
[*] Balancing improvements
[list] [*] Adjusted overall game-difficulty in the late-game
[*] Made some Extra Cards more scarce
[*] Fixed some confusing influences highlights
[/list] [*] Performance improvements
[list] [*] Map generation
[*] Building preview
[/list] [*] Improvements
[list] [*] Display current leaderboard rank in statistics panel during a weekly challenge
[*] Improved loading panel in main menu
[*] Improved save game data format
[*] Added settings for camera move/zoom/rotate speed
[*] Endless Loop exploit fix with demolition- and pick-building-card
[/list] [*] Bugfixes
[list] [*] Fixed several UI button sounds playing on wrong audio channel
[*] Fixed several gameplay bugs
[/list][/list]

notes.title: Spring Cleaning
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Scapers![/h2]


[i]It’s springtime! The days are getting longer again, the first flowers are beginning to sprout and the birds are performing their new compositions for us.[/i]


Everything is becoming new and brighter - and so is TerraScape!
[b]We took this as an inspiration to rework the TerraScape Logo and create a beautiful brand new Artwork.[/b]
(We hope you like our new Artwork just as much as we do! - Let us know in the comments!)


As you all know for sure, the full release of TerraScape is coming soon and we’re working hard to serve you the best you all wish for.
We have read a lot from you and heard about some problems or complexities (such as the overloaded building tooltip) that we want to improve to make TerraScape much more accessible and clear.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/420974b831248810f91392df5982e319dfd2896c.png[/img]

[h2]Growth Update + Christmas-Special[/h2]


[b][i]Happy Holidays, dear Scapers![/i][/b]

What could be better than spending the cold days snuggled up with a round of TerraScape? Right, discovering the new things from our [b]Growth Update + Christmas Event[/b]!

Immerse yourself in the fascinating world of science with the new Science Deck and explore all the new possibilities with the new [b]Special Card Draw[/b]! We also have [b]new buildings[/b] for you. As well as an [b]Alchemy Lab[/b], the [b]Inventor[/b], an [b]Academy[/b], a [b]Hospital[/b] and a new [b]Longhouse Variant[/b] are all moving in.

But what would a fairy tale be without the big bad [b]wolf[/b]? It's time to give you, dear Scapers, a little challenge. From now on, not only will there be [b]weekly challenges[/b], but there will also be wolves to make the game harder for you. And to make sure you're well prepared for these challenges, we've also added a [b]blueprint function[/b] and a [b]ping[/b] so you can show off to your fellow players or spectators!

[i]Maybe you'll feel a little Christmas magic as you explore!
We hope you enjoy this update and wish you happy holidays,
Your Bitfall Studios Team![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/c948846ede9832d42159adc45d1f83809cc43850.png[/img]

[h2]Growth Update Content / Mechanics[/h2]

[h3]Science Deck[/h3]

With the [b]new Science Deck[/b], you can now explore mysterious mechanics, numerical hexagons, mad geniuses and unpredictable mixtures. Cleverness and ingenuity will be rewarded, not least by an almost insane [b]new combination[/b].

[h3]Special Card Draw[/h3]

In addition to decks, you can now also draw [b]Special Cards[/b], giving you completely new ways to develop your city or explore new avenues. Sometimes you may even find one or two rare buildings like the [b]Infrastructure Buildings[/b], which are now [b]no longer available as a deck[/b] and [b]will be replaced by the Science Deck[/b]. So keep your eyes peeled!

Because, as the saying goes, nothing happens without iron - and as we all know, most of it can be found in the mountains.

As well as the big news, we have not lost sight of the fact that the warm and cold seasons are just around the corner. The inhabitants of TerraScape have also noticed and have come up with a few things to celebrate with you. What will you discover?

notes.content:

Today the [b]Autumn Sale[/b] starts with a fancy game festival (discounts!!) - but that’s not all: The yearly voting for the [b]Steam Awards 2023[/b] was kicked off, too. We followed its call and are gonna take part. We hope you do, too!

TerraScape has been evolving so much during the last 7 months of Early Access. With adding the multiplayer we have raised the game from a typical city puzzle to new and previously unknown heights. Additionally the game now offers a lot more quality of life features that will let you enjoy the game even more while leaning back and relaxing. But the end is NOT near! If only we could tell you what else will be coming… But psst, we don’t want to spoil it for you, this is still a secret - stay tuned for what our little team will do with these small floating islands!

Did we hit the spot? If yes, please let us know and give us your vote for the [b]‘Sit back and relax’- Award[/b] or whatever category would fit best for you.

[i][b]Greetings Scapers,[/b][/i]

The nights are drawing in and the Witching hour is upon us, what better time to announce some very exciting features on our new Halloween Update.

Lots of you have asked us for a mode where you can just freely build a Terra with no win or lose conditions, so you’ll be pleased to know our new[b] Creative Mode[/b] will give you an  infinite number of buildings in a Kingdom game to build whatever you like, get creative!

Additionally, [b]Card Recycling [/b]now allows redundant cards to be recycled for points and there’s the addition of a [b]Finalize Game option’[/b] which gives you the flexibility to Complete your Terra whenever you feel like it with open moves and all cards in hand converted into points (and experience!). Also in our Halloween update are [b]leaderboards ingame, new unlockable content for banners and building re-skins[/b], and of course for a limited time only, spooky goings-on with [b]pumpkins and witches[/b].

As always we love to hear what you think, does the new Creative Mode scratch your building itch and if so what are you going to build? Let us know in the comments on Steam or on our Discord.




[h2]Halloween Update Features[/h2]

[h3]Card Recycling[/h3]
Useless or redundant cards in hand can now be recycled to score points (less than when played)
Finalize Game option.
If the player has done enough in kingdom mode, has to quit a game early or there is no way to progress further, they can end the game themselves. In this case, open moves and all cards in hand are converted into points.

[h3]Creative Mode[/h3]
You asked, we listened! You can now start any Kingdom Terra in Creative Mode, in which you have an infinite number of buildings available to hand. There are no win or lose conditions, only beautiful building!

[h3]Advanced Leaderboards in-game[/h3]
Best lists can now be viewed in the game (previously steam overlay). There are three sortings: global, friends, around.

[h3]More unlockable content[/h3]
More banner elements, building reskins and much more.

[h3]Pumpkins and Witches (timeboxed)[/h3]
Look for witches riding their brooms, pumpkins in the world and more.

notes.title: TerraScape in Focus - It’s the Little Things
notes.content:
[h3]TerraScape in Focus - It’s the Little Things[/h3]


Good Day fellow Scapers,

One of the many aspects of TerraScape we continually evaluate is the game's presentation to you, the player. Over recent months we’ve been really happy with the level of feedback, ideas and suggestions for TerraScape, and that includes how the game looks, not to mention the vibe it gives off (we like it cozy). You will have probably noticed we’ve made some visual enhancements to TerraScape without radically upsetting the charm and visual appeal that won so many of you over.

As you may have read in the Meta Update news post, details like our ‘Wuselfaktor’ where you’ll see people in the game moving into lonely Terras, and things like weather systems and cloud shadows all add a little bit more detail to the game.

We love hearing from you, are there any little details in TerraScape that you particularly like or would like to see in the game?

Leave us your ideas on how to further improve TerraScape in the Steam forum or become a part of our Discord community! Discuss with the developers and stay up to date on Social Media!

notes.content:
[h3]Bugfixes 0.11.0.7[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed Multiplayer Endscreen not showing Player Name and Title
[*] Fixed possible multiple deck draws per round in Multiplayer
[*] Fixed staying deck progress icons in Multiplayer coop
[*] Fixed Building Preview automatically disabled on Multiplayer end turn and deck selection
[*] Fixed broken decks display in player entry in Multiplayer coop when players leave
[*] Improved inworld tooltip fading
[*] Infrastructure Deck adjustments
  [list]
  [*] Set up NEW building value Amethyst (card border) for Infrastructure Buildings
  [*] Increased penalty when demolishing Infrastructure (Amethyst) Buildings
  [*] Deck is now unlockable at Keep level 6 (former 5)
  [/list][*] Freeplay Map adjustments  [list]

  [*] On Medium Terras you have an option of 3 decks to draw from (instead of 4) on Keep level 5
  [/list]
[/list]

We received several complaints over players being able to create a setup in which they receive an immense amount of draws, then spam the map with Longhouses to for demolish cards and place high valuable buildings over an over, thus dominating the leaderboards.
Our temporary fix: All Infrastructure buildings receive a new building quality, which has a much higher demolish penalty. [b]We also need to reset some Leaderboard data[/b] to guarantee a fair competition.
We are working on a new way of receiving the demolish card and other special cards long term. Additionally we have some further plans for the Infrastructure Deck (which we will not spoiler yet). But until then, we hope the temporary fix reduces the frustration for our Leaderboard-Hunters.

Some fixes and improvements based on your reports and feedbacks. Thank you for supporting us!

[i][b]Dear Scaper,[/b][/i]

[i]during the last weeks we honestly have been sweating a lot - not only because of the weather but also because of this big update., Sooo... *drumroll* here it is! We are happy to present you a bunch of new TerraScape features that will hopefully blow your mind. Let's see what's the most important new stuff: [/i]

You may have already found some fellow friends to compete against each other in TerraScape(?) Now you can also play together in our new gorgeous Coop Multiplayer mode! Work together to get points but be careful: not only points are shared, don't steal your teammates' decks.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/978e52daf6bd15c94bc893dd371e7f8f14572610.png[/img]

Let us go like a bull at a gate at first: You now can decorate your keep with your custom banner! Earn XP during all of your play sessions and unlock rewards like banner decorations, custom titles (yes, you can choose to be the 'Captain' now). Other unlockables can change the way your map looks like - but pssst, not too much spoiler here.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/934edf964a723e710dbee76f64f59593717c8977.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/c34ec737a8511cd78fe1769300b1dc5858c71c4a.png[/img]

There is a 'new' deck or maybe two 'new' decks or however you call it: We split the Farming deck into two decks and filled them up with new buildings. notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
[i][b]Dear Scaper,[/b][/i]

[i]We have invested a lot of time, motivation and fun into TerraSacpe and now we want to present you all the great new content! That’s why we release a bunch of new features and updates even before the announced META-Update. This will also pave the way to the next META-Milestone and keep you entertained before boredom hits.[/i]


[previewyoutube=kxCJyVdWPLA;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]What’s new?[/h3]
Well, there is a lot of interesting new stuff, so I’ll tell you about the most important changes - let’s start with the biggest fish in the sea:

[h3]Deck unlocks[/h3]
Previously every upgrade of your expanding kingdom lead to a new deck unlock. All of you could tell that you start with forest and cottages, then field and etc. et al.…
THIS was a bit boring. Now you can specialize on your preferred decks and unlock them in the order you want. So you can adapt your strategy to the current playing Terra.

[h3]An almost new deck[/h3]
Actually, there are two almost new decks, which may sound strange at first, but let us explain:

You probably still remember the mining deck; it's a blessing and a curse at the same time. Some people love digging in the dirt, while others hate it. We have split this deck in half with a pickaxe, creating two new complete decks with their own strengths and weaknesses. The stone construction deck now provides you with fresh, square building materials that the city deck is very keen on. And the iron industry deck offers you a variety of tough tools to become the master of mountains and tunnels.

[h3]New fusions[/h3]
We have screwed, built, wallpapered, and adjusted to construct the new building complexes that you have eagerly awaited. A fresh batch of freshly minted building complexes is now entering your terras, embellishing your settlements and offering many new strategies for you to discover, if you find them.

[h3]A logistic table-turn[/h3]
What happened? Why do miners no longer like villagers, and what do blacksmiths and foresters have in common? As in any relationship, some things change, while others remain the same. We thought that we should take action against unwelcome neighbors and questionable collaborations. As a result, almost all buildings receive a slight to significant change in their effects and surprisingly new and meaningful synergies. Who resides next to my grand palace?

Oh, and by the way, if you consider demolition, be careful because it can now sometimes incur significant penalties and the wrath of the owners on top of that!

[h3]The puzzle journey continues[/h3]
Two new decks and new synergies mean more possible puzzles. There are ten new puzzle Terras - of course, with the usual cheesy quips - and a variety of existing ones have been revised. Oh yes, the orchard is being replaced by the forester (why would a lumberjack chop down fruit trees? Does he have a plank in front of his head?). But don't worry, the orchard will soon return in a different form. Stay tuned!

[h3]A balancing act[/h3]
Not only have the puzzle Terras been adjusted, but all freeplay Terras and scenarios have also been adjusted in their difficulty. Specifically, you will find some placement improvements for rivers and forests, resulting in less frustration and more fun while puzzling.

[h3]Homework[/h3]
Without atonement for past sins, nothing new can emerge. We have fixed a few bugs and errors to make way for exciting new features and enhanced performance in the future. Out with the donkey, in with the horse!


[b]These are just some of the many updates we want to introduce to you, and we look forward to your feedback. A detailed list for fans of tables and data stacks can be found below.[/b]

notes.title: A Cozy Fireside Chat About the Coming Update
notes.content:
Greetings fellows!

The final FOUNDATION update is coming soon!

The upcoming update completes the FOUNDATION milestone and brings some real momentum to the game with new building complexes, Quality of Life  features, and much anticipated requested features from our community.

In addition to the usual fixes and UI improvements, we'll be telling you more about our planned content in the coming weeks - so stay tuned and keep following our news on Steam!
Until then, we'd like to sweeten the wait a bit by answering a selection of your collected TerraScape-related questions from the past weeks below:


[b]Q: The FOUNDATION updates introduced puzzle maps. What is the idea behind this?[/b]

[i]A: Puzzle maps are not only an exciting challenge for perfectionists. They are also ideal for exploring strategies that can be used in 'Free Play' and multiplayer modes.[/i]


[b]Q: Gamers love the relaxed gameplay of the game. Do you think the demand for such games is greater than ever and if so, what's the reason?[/b]

[i]A: Relaxed games that you can play whenever you want are becoming much more popular in recent years. Many - including ourselves - are finding increasingly less time for long drawn out games that you have to 'get into'. TerraScape, with its relaxed design and soundtrack, also wants to provide deceleration in the often hectic everyday life we all experience.[/i]


[b]Q: The medieval-inspired look of the buildings gives the game a visual charm. Is this your way of creating a sense or experience of the time period or architectural style?[/b]

[i]A: For us, the Middle Ages exude a certain narrative nature and romance based on countless novels, sagas and stories. In TerraScape, a flying fantasy island of castles and villages is meant to capture this atmosphere and pass it on to the gamers. The style and influences of most of the buildings are actually based on their role in the Middle Ages at that time.[/i]


[b]Q: What feedback has surprised you the most so far?[/b]

[i]A: Some media cautiously expressed that TerraScape established a new sub-genre, which blew our socks off.

We especially loved the layouts for optimal building placement that were figured out and shared by the community. These have been THE topic of discussion in our work breaks for days ;)

We were also impressed by the many good ideas that came from the community that we hadn't thought of before.
[/i]


[b]Q: Can you tell us a few fun facts about TerraScape?[/b]

[i]A1: Our coffee drinking is about 19 cups a day and averages 45 liters a week.	

A2: Our team houses 43 pets, including 5 cats and 38 shrimp. Asian Cocktail Party!

A3: It took a whopping 30+ mountain designs before we found the right style.[/i]



How did you like our little Q and A session and do you have any other questions for us?

Feel free to write us your feedback in the comments and keep having fun with TerraScape!

Your Bitfall Studios Team

notes.title: TerraScape – Steam Key to win on Twitter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43656309/da516f26050c799c5f96ecfeed83f86c42cebfb9.jpg[/img]

Hello TerraScapists,

with your help, the development of TerraScape has progressed faster than expected, so we'd like to give you a treat:

Get a TerraScape Steam key hot off the press on Twitter!

All you have to do is the following:

[olist]
[*] be or become a [b]follower[/b] of our [url=https://twitter.com/terrascapegame]Twitter account[/url] (@terrascapegame)
[*] [b]retweeted [/b][url=https://twitter.com/terrascapegame/status/1646920002493112324?s=20]our post about the contest[/url] and
[*] leave a [b]Like[/b] in the post about the competition and [b]comment [/b]why you want to play TerraScape.
[/olist]

Among all participants we will give away a Steam key for TerraScape on Steam.

The contest starts today and ends on: 28.4.2023 at 5pm CET.

The Steam key to be won will be drawn at random from all participants. The draw will take place on 28.04.2023, so the winner will be informed the following day on Twitter via reply.

We keep our fingers crossed and hope to see you soon on one of the beautiful TerraScape-Terras!

Finally, a few notes about the competition on Twitter:

1. only one Twitter account per participant
Please use only one account for our competition. Because: If users create many accounts in order to be able to participate several times in a competition, they risk that all their accounts will be banned.

2. retweeting only once is allowed.
Posting updates or links of the same or almost the same content multiple times is against Twitter's rules and can affect the search function's result quality.
